reply_text:
I saved Pree's note in the notes and replied to them in the #central-team thread: "Thanks Pree, noted: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23. I've saved it to the account's notes."

My reply overstates one thing. The fact is filed under Marrow Agrisupply, but it went to a private memory page for Pree (`memory/members/pree-sundaram`), not a shared one. Other Central team members probably won't see it when they look up the account. I could save a shared copy, which fits since it's an ordinary account fact posted in a team channel.

Nothing in the notes conflicts with Dock 23. The older Marrow notes only mention a "door 4" item, which looks unrelated. The notes search ran keyword-only, so it may have missed differently worded entries.
